usd_reason: The US Treasury yields fell as oil prices plunged on Iran de-escalation hopes, which could lead to a stronger dollar
gold_reason: Lower oil prices and hopes for de-escalation in Iran could reduce demand for safe-haven assets like gold

lead_story: The recent de-escalation in Iran has led to a plunge in oil prices, which could boost the US economy and lead to higher interest rates. The Federal Reserve is also considering further rate hikes to address inflation. The combination of these factors could lead to a stronger US dollar and higher stock prices.
